description: Generate ecommerce images with the Nano Banana base image model.

fields.name: imageUrls
fields.description: Public reference image URLs required by this image generation API. When supplied, provide 1 to 10 JPG, PNG, or WEBP images; each image must not exceed 20 MB.

fields.name: prompt
fields.description: Generation prompt describing the target image, scene, composition, style, and constraints. Maximum 5000 characters.
fields.example: Keep the product consistent and generate a clean white-background ecommerce hero image.

fields.name: outputNum
fields.description: Number of images to generate. Valid range: 1 to 10; defaults to 1.

example.prompt: Keep the product consistent and generate a clean white-background ecommerce hero image.
